declarations.name: playElementAnimation
declarations.description: Imperative trigger, runs the configured animation on this element right now.

declarations.name: startAnimationController
declarations.description:
Boot the controller. Idempotent, calling it multiple times is fine
(the second call is a no-op). Typically driven by the side-effect
import of `@fluid-ds/animations/define/controller`.

declarations.name: stopElementAnimation
declarations.description: Cancel the running animation (if any) on this element.

declarations.name: RAINBOW
declarations.description: A cheerful, brand-independent palette used by `pride`-style presets.

declarations.name: brandColors
declarations.description:
Opt-in brand palette: read a range of the live Fluid brand ramp from the
document, so a burst is tinted to the active brand / theme (blue on the
default brand, graphite on Titanium, and so on). Pass it as an effect's
`colors`: `confetti({ colors: brandColors() })`. Falls back to the default
blue ramp off-DOM or when tokens are empty.

declarations.name: defaultColors
declarations.description: Brand-independent fallback palette for generic celebration effects.

declarations.name: pick
declarations.description: Pick a pseudo-random color from a palette.

declarations.name: resolvePalette
declarations.description:
Resolve a working palette: the supplied colors when non-empty, otherwise the
generic celebration fallback. Effects can pass their purpose-tuned palette
here; consumers can pass `brandColors()` to brand-tint.

declarations.name: activeEmitterCount
declarations.description: Test-only: how many emitters are currently active.

declarations.name: activeParticleCount
declarations.description:
Test-only: total live particles across every active emitter. Lets a test
watch that an effect stops spawning (the count holds or falls) rather than
runs away (it climbs), without waiting for slow particles to fully drain.

declarations.name: addEmitter
declarations.description:
Register an emitter with the engine and start the shared loop if it is
not already running. When motion is reduced the emitter does NOT
animate: its optional static frame is painted once, then it resolves.

declarations.name: drawLegacyParticle
declarations.deprecated: Internal fallback; public effects use tree-shakeable scoped renderers.

declarations.name: isCanvasMounted
declarations.description: Test-only: is the shared canvas currently in the DOM.

declarations.name: prefersReducedMotion
declarations.description: True when the user asked for reduced motion. SSR-safe.

declarations.name: stopEmitter
declarations.description: Stop an emitter immediately: its remaining particles are dropped.

declarations.name: viewport
declarations.description: Current viewport size in CSS px.

declarations.name: windDownEmitter
declarations.description:
Wind an emitter down gracefully: it spawns no more particles (its `update` is
never called again), but the ones already on screen finish their motion, and
the emitter ends itself and resolves once they are gone. Contrast with
stopEmitter, which drops the particles at once. This reuses the same
"spawn no more" path a `duration` uses when it elapses, so a manual stop
fizzles out exactly like a timed one.

members.name: colors
members.description: Color override, settable as a JS property (array) or `colors` attr.

members.name: originTarget
members.description:
Optional element used by `origin="self"`. Useful when the transparent
controller sits next to, rather than around, the element being celebrated.

members.name: #emojis
members.description: Emoji glyph override (array), settable as a property or the `emojis` attr.

members.name: emojis
members.description:
Emoji glyphs the emoji presets cycle through, picked at random per
particle. Settable as a property (array) or the space/comma-separated
`emojis` attribute. Updating it while `auto` is set re-fires the effect.

members.name: #maybeRefire
members.description:
When `auto` is set and the element is connected, re-run the effect on the
next frame after a config change. Coalesced so flipping several attributes
at once fires only once.

members.name: fire
members.description:
Fire the configured effect once. Resolves when the burst ends, having
dispatched `fluid-celebrate-end`, unless the element was disconnected
mid-burst (e.g. via `stop()` from `disconnectedCallback`), in which case
the end event is suppressed because it could not reach delegated listeners.

members.name: stop
members.description: Stop the current effect, if any.

declarations.name: EFFECTS

declarations.description: Canonical callable registry used by `<fluid-celebrate>` and galleries.

declarations.name: EFFECT_CATALOG
declarations.description:
Canonical effect metadata. The public names, declarative wrapper, docs
gallery, and standalone animation lab all derive from this list so adding an
effect no longer requires several independent name registries.

declarations.name: EFFECT_NAMES
declarations.description: Every effect name, derived from EFFECT_CATALOG.

declarations.name: emojiBurst
declarations.description: A point burst of emoji (or image) particles.

declarations.name: hearts
declarations.description: A burst of heart glyphs.

declarations.name: stars
declarations.description: A burst of star glyphs.

declarations.name: drawAnyShape
declarations.description: Full shape renderer used only by effects that accept arbitrary user shapes.

declarations.name: getAnimation
declarations.description: Look up a registered animation.

declarations.name: hasAnimation
declarations.description: True when an animation under this name has been registered.

declarations.name: listAnimations
declarations.description: Every registered animation name in registration order.

declarations.name: onAnimationRegistered
declarations.description:
Subscribe to registration events. Returns an unsubscribe function.
The controller uses this to (re-)play animations on elements whose
named animation arrived after the attribute was already set.

declarations.name: registerAnimation
declarations.description:
Register an animation under a name. Overwrites if the name is already
taken, useful for theming a default animation without forking the
package.
